Name: Q's Crib Retexture
Author: Queina1
Description:
If you're like me and you think the vanilla crib is boring, this mod is for you. I have retextured the vanilla crib and added 12 more designs. Plus a bonus pink crib to match the child's bed from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12669]Pretty Pink Furniture[/url] by twinkle22 who gave me permission to make a matching crib. Not all designs are shown. The expanded beds are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10023]Bed Tweaks[/url]. 

Vanilla, Oak, and Walnut match the vanilla furniture. Then the rest match all the extra double beds available in the game:

Birch
Deluxe
Exotic
Fisher
Modern
Pirate
Starry
Strawberry
Tropical
Wild

If you like this mod, please take a moment to endorse it. Thank you.
